territorial_scope.description: Applies to processing within Nigeria and to controllers or processors not domiciled, resident or operating in Nigeria that process personal data of a data subject in Nigeria.

evidence.quote: but is processing personal data of a data subject in Nigeria.

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Regulates the processing of personal data by data controllers and processors, including foreign controllers processing data of persons in Nigeria. Creates the Nigeria Data Protection Commission and sets principles, lawful bases, data subject rights, breach notification and cross-border transfer rules. Assented 12 June 2023.
summary.long: The Act regulates processing of personal data by data controllers and data processors, whether automated or not, where the controller or processor is domiciled, resident or operating in Nigeria, processing occurs in Nigeria, or a non-domiciled controller processes data of a data subject in Nigeria. Processing must meet principles of fairness, purpose limitation, minimisation, accuracy, retention and security, and must rest on a lawful basis such as consent or legitimate interests. Sensitive personal data is subject to additional conditions, and consent for children requires a parent or guardian. Data subjects have rights of access, correction, erasure, objection and not to be subject to solely automated decisions with significant effects. Controllers must carry out data privacy impact assessments for high-risk processing, notify the Commission of breaches within 72 hours, and register if of major importance. Cross-border transfers require adequacy or another listed basis. The Act establishes the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, which may issue compliance and enforcement orders and impose penalties. Penalty maxima are the greater of N10,000,000 or 2% of annual gross revenue for major importance entities, and the greater of N2,000,000 or 2% otherwise. Offences are punishable by fines and imprisonment, and data subjects may complain to the Commission and recover damages. The text sets no commencement date; it refers only to the commencement of the Act.

notes: Text is the Act as published in Official Gazette No. 119 (1 July 2023); assent is recorded as 12 June 2023. The text has a 'Commencement' heading but no commencement date, and ss.19(3) and 44(1) refer to commencement. No amendment or repeal clause appears. Margin notes 'Act No. 4, 2014', 'Act No. 26, 2003', 'Act No. 16, 2022' and 'Cap. P41, LFN, 2004' sit beside provisions naming other Acts; 'Act No. 16, 2022' is not linked by name in the text and is not coded. Social security laws listed in s.65 (Employee Compensation Act, National Health Insurance Authority Act, National Housing Fund Act, Nigeria Social Insurance Trust Fund Act, Industrial Trust Fund Act) are not coded as separate relations. The major-importance threshold in s.65 is set by the Commission, so no number is given. s.43(1) reads 'section ż42', a scan artefact for section 42.

“personal data” means any information relating to an individual, who can be identified or is identifiable, directly or indirectly
“data controller” means an individual, private entity, public Commission, agency or any other body who, alone or jointly with others, determines the purposes and means of processing of personal data
“data processor” means an individual, private entity, public authority, or any other body, who processes personal data on behalf of or at the direction of a data controller or another data processor

definitions.term: data controller or data processor of major importance

evidence.quote: “data controller or data processor of major importance” means a data controller or data processor that is domiciled, resident in, or operating in Nigeria
“data subject” means an individual to whom personal data relates
“processing” means any operation or set of operations which is performed on personal data, whether or not by automated means
“sensitive personal data” means personal data relating to an individual’s
“biometric data” means personal data resulting from specific technical processing relating to the physical, physiological, or behavioural characteristics of an individual
“automated decision-making” means a decision based solely on automated processing by automated means, without any human involvement
“consent” means any freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous indication, whether by a written or oral statement or an affirmative action
“child” has the meaning ascribed in the Child’s Right Act, No. 26, 2003
“competent authority” includes
“personal data breach” means a breach of security of a data controller or data processor leading to or likely to lead to the accidental or unlawful destruction
